SubFlows.Title: Select ListBox Value Inside Active Row

Value.Value: The parent node of a row is known as the "Section Name." For example, "All Purchase Orders" acts as the parent node when searching within the "Procurement and Sourcing >> All Purchase Orders" table. This distinction is useful when navigating multiple tables in the UI.
This sub-flow will work on active row only, to select a value from listbox available inside the active row of a table.
